newsitem.title: USA: NRG Energy completes Boliviana Power tender.
newsitem.headline: NRG Energy completes Boliviana Power tender.

text.p: NRG Energy Inc said Thursday its cash tender offer for all outstanding shares of Compania Boliviana de Energia Electrica SA-Boliviana Power Co Ltd expired, and it has bought 95 percent of the shares at the cash price of $43.00 a share.
As of the expiration at 12 midnight EST Wednesday, NRG said about 3,991,774 shares had been tendered and not withdrawn.
"NRG has accepted these shares for payment at the purchase price of $43.00 per share in cash," the company said in a statement.
In November, NRG said it entered into a definitive agreement to purchase Boliviana Power.
